mapper.sql: FROM tb_credential_groups g JOIN tb_completions cp ON cp.id = g.completion_id JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id JOIN tb_courses co ON co.id = e.course_id
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT institution_id::text AS institution_id FROM ( SELECT co.institution_id FROM tb_credentials c JOIN tb_credential_groups g ON g.id = c.credential_group_id JOIN tb_completions cp ON cp.id = g.completion_id JOIN tb_enrollments e ON e.id = cp.enrollment_id JOIN tb_courses co ON co.id = e.course_id WHERE c.sign_key_id IS NULL AND c.status IN ('ISSUING', 'ISSUED', 'SUPERSEDED', 'REVOKED', 'EXPIRED') UNION SELECT l.institution_id FROM tb_credential_status_lists l WHERE l.sign_key_id IS NULL ) unlinked ORDER BY institution_id::text

UPDATE tb_credentials c SET sign_key_id = #{signKeyId}, sign_key_version = 0, sign_attempt_no = 1, vc_jws_header = CASE WHEN c.vc_payload IS NOT NULL AND left(c.vc_payload, 1) = '{' THEN split_part(c.vc_payload::jsonb ->> 'compactJws', '.', 1) END, vc_jws_payload = CASE WHEN c.vc_payload IS NOT NULL AND left(c.vc_payload, 1) = '{' THEN split_part(c.vc_payload::jsonb ->> 'compactJws', '.', 2) END
WHERE c.credential_group_id = g.id AND co.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND c.sign_key_id IS NULL AND c.status IN ('ISSUING', 'ISSUED', 'SUPERSEDED', 'REVOKED', 'EXPIRED')
UPDATE tb_credential_status_lists SET sign_key_id = #{signKeyId}, sign_key_version = 0 WHERE institution_id = #{institutionId} AND sign_key_id IS NULL
